counter_availability: Two consecutive fully available samples; matching epoch/exporter/series; send and receive gaps and each RTT <=3s; no overlap; no reset; latest send age <=3s
control_assumption: Premeasurement plan, zero delay, integer-second left endpoints
response_scoring: Diagnostic predicted ranking and training support only, no policy value or causal verification
data: The same eight qualified full captures as transition-prototype-v1; no smoke, failed cap16-r2 or C
sequence_encoding: One column per planned cap step, replacing first/mean/last summaries; fixed ridge alpha=1
prediction_contract: Finite consistent core state; missing flags for engine observations; default reject unseen applied-cap/planned-sequence patterns; explicit separate diagnostic overrides
grouped_holdout: For each fixed cap exclude all repeated fixed runs; remove all training origins whose applied or within-horizon planned cap equals that level. Earlier workload history can remain.
